name: Locations
description: Registry of regions and towns behind the address fields: import a prepared CSV pack per country, then search, edit, disable or add places by hand. Rows an admin touched are never overwritten by the next import, so local corrections survive a data update.

settings.label: Folder with prepared packs
settings.help: Relative to the project root. The import screen lists every <country>-states.csv / <country>-cities.csv pair it finds there, so a pack can be dropped in by file rather than uploaded.

settings.label: Types not offered to customers
settings.help: A ticked type disappears from the city field in the cart and the checkout; the places stay in the registry, keep their zones and are still searchable in the admin. "City district" is the usual one to switch off — those rows are neighbourhoods of a bigger city, and a customer names the city. Be careful with the two centres: administratively they are seats of a district or a community, but they are ordinary towns as well (Polevskoy, 66 000 people, is one), so switching them off hides real destinations.

settings.label: Ask "Is your town …?" on the first visit
settings.help: A small window under the town in the header: "Your town is Kyiv? Yes / Change". Shown to a visitor who has not chosen a town, once a visit; "Yes" remembers the town as if it was picked by hand. The browser's location asks the visitor's permission first — the browser's own question, before ours. By IP needs a city database file below; where neither finds a town, the shop's own town is offered, and with none set nothing is asked.

settings.label: The shop's own town
settings.help: Its name as the registry has it (Kyiv, Київ — any language); the most populous of the same name is taken. Offered when nothing else knows the town.

settings.label: City database by IP (.mmdb)
settings.help: Relative to the project root, e.g. data/geo/dbip-city-lite.mmdb. A free one: DB-IP "IP to City Lite" (CC BY 4.0 — the licence asks for a link to db-ip.com on the site) or MaxMind GeoLite2 City (free account). Replace the file monthly to keep it fresh.
